model: Original procedural Three.js geometry for all five species. No human model is loaded by the runtime. Historical Kenney files and licenses remain archived in the repository.
selection: No player selection. URL character values and former local preferences are ignored. Old mascot.html links redirect directly into the game.
scope: All local and remote players are wind droplets. Citrus, stone guardian, cloud and sprout are NPC-only, including walking, seated, policy and volunteer roles.
brand: Existing original Sumgyeol symbol on backpacks; native proportions preserved. Separate brand rights are not relicensed as CC0.
performance: Shared geometry/materials per species. Distant standing companions use one merged coloured mesh; nearby friends retain animated face and limbs. Seated characters use a dedicated pose and .74 visual scale with their underside aligned to the actual seat height.
multiplayer: Players always broadcast the wind species index and render remote players as wind, including old clients carrying another appearance. Movement, connection counts and no-chat validation are unchanged.

verification.playerInvariant: wind even when legacy kind or character query is supplied
